hero.title: Cycle #{n}
hero.subtitle: Opened {date} • {count, plural, one {{count} gesture} other {{count} gestures}} made

countdown.finalizesTooltip: When this timer hits zero, the participant who made the Final Gesture may finalize the cycle and retrieve the Signature Allocation. Each new gesture extends the timer.
countdown.confirmingMessage: The clock reached zero. Checking the chain for a last-second Gesture before the cycle can finalize.

totalGestures.label: Total Gestures
totalGestures.tooltip: Total gestures made in this cycle. Each gesture is also a Stellar Selection entry.

cycleReserve.label: Cycle Reserve
cycleReserve.tooltip: ETH portion of the Signature Allocation retrieved by the participant who made the Final Gesture. The recipient also receives 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT.

stellarSelectionPool.label: Stellar Selection Pool
stellarSelectionPool.tooltip: ETH split across {count} randomly selected participants when the cycle finalizes.

publicGoods.label: Public Goods
publicGoods.tooltip: {percent}% of the Cycle Reserve is forwarded to Protocol Guild each cycle.

contributedEth.label: Contributed ETH
contributedEth.tooltip: Direct ETH contributions from the community this cycle.

attachedNfts.label: Attached NFTs
attachedNfts.tooltip: NFTs attached to gestures by the community this cycle.

allocationTracks.title: Allocation Tracks
allocationTracks.tooltip: How the Cycle Reserve distributes across allocation tracks: Signature Allocation, Chrono-Warrior, Stellar Selection, Public Goods, Anchor Distribution, and the Compounding Cycle Reserve.

stellarSelectionEntries.title: Stellar Selection Entries
stellarSelectionEntries.tooltip: Each gesture records one Stellar Selection entry. More gestures = higher Selection frequency for ETH or Cosmic Signature NFT allocations.

topEthSpenders.title: Top ETH Spenders
topEthSpenders.tooltip: Participant addresses ranked by total ETH spent on gestures this cycle.

enduranceChampions.title: Endurance Champions
enduranceChampions.tooltip: Participants ranked by how long they remained the most-recent gesture maker. The one with the longest consecutive interval receives a Recognition CST imprint of 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT.

gestureHistory.title: Gesture History — Cycle {n}
gestureHistory.tooltip: Chronological record of every gesture made in this cycle, newest first.

ethContributions.title: ETH Contributions
ethContributions.tooltip: Direct ETH contributions made by community members during this cycle.

cycleRules.title: Cycle Rules
cycleRules.tooltip: Key rules and allocation mechanics for this cycle.

rules.participation: When you gesture, you may imprint dynamic Participation CST. The amount uses a square-root formula based on how long it has been since the previous gesture.
rules.participationV3: When you gesture, you may imprint dynamic Participation CST. The amount accrues at a steady rate based on how long it has been since the previous gesture.
rules.calibration: ETH gestures shorten the CST Calibration Window by about {decreasePercent}%; CST gestures lengthen it by about {increasePercent}%.
rules.stellarSelection: Each gesture records one Stellar Selection entry. {ethEntries} entries receive {rafflePercent}% of the Cycle Reserve. {nftEntries} additional Selection recipients and {anchorHolders} Random Walk NFT anchor-holders receive a Cosmic Signature NFT.
rules.publicGoods: Protocol Guild receives {percent}% of the Cycle Reserve (at least {amount} ETH) each cycle.

attachedTokens.title: Attached Tokens
attachedTokens.tooltip: NFTs and ERC-20 tokens attached to gestures by the community to enrich the cycle's Cycle Reserve.
attachedTokens.erc721Empty: No ERC721 tokens were attached this cycle.
